habitat: Lakes; reservoirs; slow flowing rivers; swamps; bays; lagoons; and estuaries
story: In the diverse world of birds, the Great Crested Grebe (Podiceps cristatus) stands out. This species, part of the Podicipedidae family, is a resident of Lakes; reservoirs; slow flowing rivers; swamps; bays; lagoons; and estuaries. Its IUCN Red List status is Least Concern (LC), which serves as a call to action for habitat preservation. The Great Crested Grebe is more than just a bird; it is a symbol of the rich biodiversity that we must protect. Through this poster, we hope to foster a greater understanding and appreciation for the Great Crested Grebe and its role in the ecosystem.
Every poster is crafted to inspire curiosity about our planet's incredible biodiversity.
